summary: The user is experiencing BSODs with an unexpected_store_exception error code while gaming on their Acer Aspire VX 15. The issue started after installing a Windows update (KB4034674) and uninstalling RivaTuner, which was incompatible with the new version of Windows.
detected_fault: Outdated Wi-Fi driver may be causing the issue due to incompatibility with the new Windows version.
suggested_solution: Update all drivers to their latest versions and check for any remaining outdated drivers that may be causing the issue.
